rv.q: Director Evan Jackson, who adapted the script, gives us a very strong rendering of ‘Pericles,’ eliciting strong performances and engaging staging...
Even though Act 1 could be slimmed down and tightened up, it’s nice to be back in Idle Muse’s company.
Unfortunately the results are uneven, at best.
The journeys are all there, but the excitement is missing.
Idle Muse Theatre Company has done an expert job in bringing this world premiere production about the daughters of Tyre to an enthusiastic audience, and you should be a part of it!

cn.t: This feminist adaptation of Shakespeare's "Pericles" retains the Bard's language while empowering female characters, earning modest praise for its ambition and craft despite the constraints of a small storefront stage.
